notice: English renderings of the Korean location notes in the Perofunyang catalog. Hand written, not machine translated, and keyed by map so that point ids repeated across maps stay separate. tools/build-battlepass.cjs merges them into app/data/battlepass-spawns.json as the `note` field; the Korean original is always kept as `sourceNote` and still shown in the app. Notes that only repeat the point id, or that hinge on a Korean community nickname with no confirmed English equivalent, are left out on purpose rather than guessed: a missing note is better than a wrong room.
